examples.en: It is warm today, friend. It is warm indeed! I am sweating, and the sheep are lying under the pine. Where do the sheep drink? They drink at the spring. Its water is cold. Let us sit under the pine!

examples.pie: kʷíd tébʰye bʰebʰéydʰoh₂? wiḱpótim préḱsdʰi ne dʰrugʰyéti. kʷíd toy wiḱpóteyey bʰebʰéydʰoh₂? nu moy h₂éwh₂om préḱsdʰi. dʰǵʰémi Hn̥dʰér ḱéyor bʰágons préḱsdʰi. smḗymi bʰebʰóydʰh₂e-kʷe toy.
examples.en: Why should I trust you? Ask the master of the house; he does not lie. And why should I trust the master of your house? Then ask my grandfather! He lies under the earth; ask the gods! I laugh, and I trust you.

examples.pie: ḱḗr mē tréms deywós te péh₂sti. kʷsép l̥gʰdʰí h₂éwsōs h₁ludʰḗti ḱḗr Hwr̥dʰdʰí.

examples.pie: gʰrómom ḱlush₁yési? h₁ím ḱlush₁yóh₂. pérkʷunos kl̥Hn̥bʰós gʷm̥sḱéti. kúdʰe ḱélōmesdʰh₂? dréwi Hn̥dʰí mē sth₂éh₁yes. pérkʷunos bʰérǵʰuh₂ dóruh₂ gʷʰénti. poh₂imnés dṓm drémomes.

examples.en: Sister-in-law, your goat has eaten our grain! Your brother loves that goat; he does not listen to me. Then I will speak to my brother. Speak to him! Let us shut the goat in. Let us shut him in, and let us not fight. The goat is bad; we two are sisters.
